text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "a cache must not use heuristics when an explicit expiration time is present",
      "claim_text": "A cache must not use heuristics to determine freshness when an explicit expiration time is present in the stored response.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P1.S0."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a response with Cache-Control: max-age=600 is never given a heuristic lifetime",
      "claim_text": "A response with Cache-Control: max-age=600 is never given a heuristic lifetime.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P1.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "max-age is an explicit expiration time, so heuristics are forbidden."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a shared cache treats it as fresh for 60 seconds",
      "claim_text": "If a response has s-maxage=60, a shared cache treats it as fresh for 60 seconds.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "s-maxage sets the maximum age for shared caches."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "must ignore any Expires header",
      "claim_text": "A shared cache must ignore the Expires header field when the response includes the s-maxage directive.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P8.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P8.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A client sending max-age=0 without max-stale is asking not to receive a stale response",
      "claim_text": "A client sending max-age=0 without max-stale does not wish to receive a stale response.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P3.S1 states this unless max-stale is present."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "proxy-revalidate applies only to shared caches",
      "claim_text": "proxy-revalidate applies only to shared caches.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P6.S1 says it does not apply to private caches."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a private cache holding a stale response marked proxy-revalidate may reuse it without revalidating",
      "claim_text": "A private cache holding a stale response marked proxy-revalidate may reuse it without revalidating.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S0", "rel": "entails"}, {"sid": "P6.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "The MUST NOT reuse applies to shared caches; proxy-revalidate does not apply to private caches."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "must-revalidate, by contrast, binds every cache",
      "claim_text": "must-revalidate binds every cache.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S1 says in all circumstances a cache MUST NOT ignore it."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a disconnected cache must return an error instead of the stale response",
      "claim_text": "If a cache is disconnected, it must generate an error response rather than reuse the stale response when must-revalidate is present.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A client that sends max-stale=30 will accept a response up to 30 seconds past its freshness lifetime",
      "claim_text": "A client that sends max-stale=30 will accept a response that has exceeded its freshness lifetime by no more than 30 seconds.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P4.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "but not one that is 45 seconds stale",
      "claim_text": "A client that sends max-stale=30 will not accept a response that is 45 seconds stale.",
      "kind": "arith",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": {"kind": "arith", "expr": "45", "op": ">", "value": "30"},
      "reasoning": "45 exceeds the 30-second limit in P4.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a cache uses the one with the earlier Date header",
      "claim_text": "If two suitable responses are stored, a cache uses the one with the earlier Date header.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P9.S0", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P9.S0 requires the most recent response, not the earlier one."
    }
  ]
}
